visual_brief: 乌拉尔河下游流经奥伦堡与哈萨克斯坦草原，河道蜿蜒、两岸河岸林；奥伦堡白色「欧亚分界」步行吊桥跨河是最经典景观，阿特劳河口段平阔。易混：乌拉尔山脉本身（无河）。
notes: 无合格可商用照片，建议出图。试过：Flickr CC（Ural river Orenburg / Ural river / Orenburg bridge / Оренбург Урал / река Урал / Atyrau / Atyrau river / Uralsk Kazakhstan / Уральск / Zhaiyk river / Oral Kazakhstan river / Orsk / Magnitogorsk river），只找到 2006 年卡片机拍的奥伦堡步行桥夜景（c2、c3：噪点重、高光溢出、发糊）；「река Урал」结果多是乌拉尔山区其他河流的漂流照。原 c1（阿特劳日落城市教堂，不是河）已删。Openverse 504。理想画面描述：Elevated summer photograph of the Ural River at Orenburg, Russia: the meandering green-brown river with wooded banks crossing the frame, the white cable-stayed Europe–Asia pedestrian bridge spanning it, steppe and city skyline beyond, clear golden-hour light from the side, river and bridge as the main subject. Avoid: the Ural Mountains without a river, night noise, film grain, city buildings dominating, backlit silhouettes.
pick_reason: 仅有的乌拉尔河可商用照片是低质夜景（噪点重、糊），不满足清晰好看。
